messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] HIGH: Dedicated pool pressure detected for tenant Zenovia (tenant_id: z-9c2). GPUs at 92% util, queue depth rising. Pager routed to oncall_morgan.
oncall_morgan: I'm on it — checking dashboards. Linking Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/zenovia-pool/overview
naomi: seeing sustained queue growth on /v1/generate, p50 -> p95 latency jump 120ms -> 1.2s, token rate steady. KV cache hit dropped ~30%.
arjun: cluster view: all 8 pool GPUs show memory ~99%, pods Pending due to node allocatable. Looks like scheduling backlog, not a single-node failure.
tilly: Zenovia has burst enabled but policy requires ops approval for >2x. We need customer consent for emergency +4 GPUs.
samir: pinging account_ryan for authorization, cc @oncall_morgan.
account_ryan: Zenovia reports visible degradation for paying customers. They authorize an emergency burst for up to 30 minutes. Prefer no evictions if possible.
arjun: submitting burst request to control plane: POST /admin/burst {"tenant":"z-9c2","add_gpus":4,"duration":"30m"} -> request_id abc123. Sending provisioning signal.
incident-bot: Burst request abc123 received. Provisioning nodes in region us-west-2. Estimated time to ready ~2m.
naomi: starting soft throttles for lower-priority tenants on same cluster, reduce batch sizes on best-effort routes. Applying config patches now.
arjun: new nodes registered, pods scheduled onto added capacity. GPU util dropped to ~65%, queue cleared. p95 latency down to ~180ms.
oncall_morgan: monitoring. I'll keep this thread open for a 15m stabilization window. Please post any anomalies.
arjun: creating follow-up ticket INF-2489 to investigate: pod resource requests, autoscaler thresholds, and padding that allowed headroom to be exhausted. Assigned to @eng-runtime.
tilly: proposal: lower autoscale trigger from 85% to 70% utilization for dedicated pools with single-tenant high-QPS to give more headroom.
account_ryan: Zenovia appreciates the quick action. They'll run a short test load and report if they see regressions.
oncall_morgan: closing the immediate pager — metrics stable for 10+ minutes. Recommend short incident note and no full postmortem since we had customer-authorized burst and no evictions, but follow-up ticket required.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (resolution_id: r-zz9). Duration 00:22:39. Pager cleared.
